system.boundary: Build a pack-level battery-management supervisor for a 96-cell series pack.
engineering_objects: F90-XBATT-07 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: supervisor_state, contactor_commands, current_limits, cell_extrema, fault_state
physical_paths: Hard-coded scenario traces, copied input columns, disconnected fault flags, and contactor commands that bypass the state machine or voltage feedback are not acceptable.
functional_paths: Detected critical faults must override the requested operating state and command a safe contactor response.
information_paths: bms_input -> F90-XBATT-07 plant/control path -> supervisor_state, contactor_commands, current_limits, cell_extrema, fault_state
modes_and_events: Read bms_input from the MATLAB base workspace and simulate for 25 s with a 0.1 s fixed step.

The same sensor path must drive cell-extrema extraction, voltage- and temperature-dependent charge/discharge current limits, fault supervision, BMS state transitions, and independent charger and inverter contactor sequences.
Implement standby, charging, driving, and fault states.

interfaces.name: bms_input
interfaces.description: MATLAB base-workspace input declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: Read bms_input from the MATLAB base workspace and simulate for 25 s with a 0.1 s fixed step. bms_input is a MATLAB struct with these public fields: cell_voltages_V is a 96-by-1 real vector with each value in 2.3--4.4 V; cell_temperatures_C is a 96-by-1 real vector with each value in -25--65 degC; pack_voltage_V is a real scalar in 220--430 V; pack_current_A is a real scalar in -500--500 A, with positive meaning discharge; charger_dc_voltage_V and inverter_dc_voltage_V are real scalars in 0--430 V; and state_request is an integer scalar with 0 for standby, 1 for charging, and 2 for driving.

interfaces.name: supervisor_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: supervisor_state has width 5 in this order: bms_state, charger_contactor_state, inverter_contactor_state, critical_fault, limp_mode.

interfaces.name: contactor_commands
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: contactor_commands has width 6 in this order: charger_positive, charger_precharge, charger_negative, inverter_positive, inverter_precharge, inverter_negative.

interfaces.name: current_limits
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: current_limits has width 2 in this order: discharge_current_limit_A, charge_current_limit_A; the discharge limit is non-positive and the charge limit is non-negative.

interfaces.name: cell_extrema
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: cell_extrema has width 4 in this order: minimum_cell_voltage_V, maximum_cell_voltage_V, minimum_cell_temperature_C, maximum_cell_temperature_C.

interfaces.name: fault_state
interfaces.description: Output container declared by the current public task contract.
interfaces.range_or_shape: fault_state has width 8 in this order: pack_overcurrent, cell_high_temperature, cell_low_temperature, voltage_sensor, cell_overvoltage, cell_undervoltage, charger_contactor, inverter_contactor.

signs_and_coordinates: Charging and driving requests must use their respective DC-link voltage feedback to perform a safe negative-contactor/precharge/positive-contactor sequence before declaring the path closed.
feedback_and_control_causality: Charging and driving requests must use their respective DC-link voltage feedback to perform a safe negative-contactor/precharge/positive-contactor sequence before declaring the path closed.
Current limits must respond causally to the worst cell voltage and temperature rather than merely copying pack current or a fixed nominal limit.
All logs must cover the complete simulation, remain finite, and be produced by one causal supervisor.
